title: Resonance Loom
archiveRole: GLM-5.2 Web Audio rhythm observation sample
description: A four-lane browser rhythm game where D, F, J, and K keystrokes or lane taps weave a live-synthesized melody. Three original note charts use Web Audio oscillators with no samples or external dependencies, while timing judgements, combo scoring, grades, and local high scores reward precision.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: The responsive layout and lane taps support a 390px browser viewport, but rhythm timing is designed primarily for desktop keyboard play. No physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: The supplied package declares GLM-5.2 by Z.ai as the author of all game source. The original source metadata is preserved as source-game.json; archive metadata and generated publishing assets were added during integration without changing gameplay, charts, or audio logic.

slotVariantRunPolicy.gameSlot: Observation 010 / Game 010 is the official Resonance Loom observation sample.
slotVariantRunPolicy.modelVariant: Additional AI-made versions of Resonance Loom should be stored under variants/ and must not consume new game numbers.
slotVariantRunPolicy.runRecord: Generation, revision, validation, and comparison attempts should be stored as JSON files under runs/.

keyboard: D / F / J / K to hit the four lanes
Escape to return to the menu
pointer: Select a song and use the on-screen controls
touch: Tap the four lane keys to play on touch screens
